motion_noise_generator: jax.random.normal float32 from the existing position-key stream, then cast to float64 and passed explicitly to the native movement map
reward_definition: native physical-position distance to (8.5,3.5) below 2, and not failed after the transition
head_inputs: observable F4, sampled natural advice xb, frozen-actor action xq, emitted next-XY displacement
bootstrap_weights: reuse the completed repair experiment's fixed whole-episode bootstrap weights

interpretation.A: First-entry behavior and subsequent survival/reward become credible: correct motion is sufficient for this fixed actor and setting; prioritize a trainable alive-motion reference.
interpretation.B: First-entry becomes credible but survival remains wrong: the nominal-weighted conditional onset process remains implicated.
interpretation.C: First-entry remains inconsistent: audit oracle equivalence, actor invocation, reset, goal, noise, precision, and history before learning.
interpretation.D: Uncertainty prevents a conclusion: report it without further sampling or training.

selection_or_tuning: none; two frozen-head oracle arms only
